planner.label: Planner
planner.subject: Planner: the Deleted page in design A of round V, picked by Claude as asked. Three looks were drawn in the real page (planner/design/v-deleted): A groups what was deleted by the day it went, each event a chip in its own colour with what was deleted under it and a round undo beside it; B gave each one a whole card with its facts and a Restore button; C one line each, a tap opening it like an event. A is built: Restore is the page's one action, so it is one tap, and the chips are the calendar's own (they follow Settings › Colours). Java now sends each deleted event's colour. Proof: the page e2e reads the groups, the chip colour and each undo; 88 unit tests; the real page rendered in Chromium matches the design. Asked: "Also Claude design and choose a design for that page".

warranty.label: Warranty
warranty.subject: Warranty: days since a repair started. The repair going on shows its days beside In repair (Today, 1 day, 12 days) with a blue bar under it that fills over a month and stays full after; a finished one says how long it took (Took 7 days, to the day it was completed). On home the warranty in repair has a small blue ring of the same around its wrench and reads "In repair 3 days". e2e drive passes (the bar at 0% the day it starts and 10% three days in, Took counting to the day it was done); 2 mutants red (a bar always full, Took counting to today). Asked: "Days since repair started" (for a blue progress bar on a repair).

weight.label: Weight
weight.subject: Weight: a home-screen widget, design B with Home's whole chart. The last weigh-in big with Home's chip beside it (kg a day, or the change in N days), the kg to go top right, and under them the eight weeks as Home draws them: the kg over every point with room, the first day, the goal on its date with its kg and day, and today's pace carried to that date, blue on track and red not. Drawn natively to whatever size it is given, in Manrope and the person's own colour on AMOLED black; a tap opens Weight. The page hands over whoever Home shows (colour, weigh-ins, goals) and Java does Home's sums again at every draw (WidgetPlan), so it moves on by itself with the app closed and turns light blue when Home switches to Mummy. Home's chip words moved into plan.js (chipOf), used by both.

translate.label: Translate
translate.subject: Translate: English or Thai is found by itself. Whatever you type, the app reads which language it is from the letters: more Thai letters than English ones is Thai (the English comes out), else English (the Thai comes out), so one Thai word in an English line ("I want to eat ข้าว") no longer turns the whole line round; numbers alone, or as many of each, go the way the button is set. After each translation the ไทย / EN button, the box's words and the widget's bar follow what you typed, and the keyboard is asked for that language the next time the box opens (not mid-word, which would break the typing). javacheck 35/35 (2 new tests); 2 mutants red (any Thai letter = Thai, a tie ignoring the button). Asked: "Can translate auto detect if it's eng or Thai please".

reddit.label: Reddit Snoo
reddit.subject: Reddit Snoo: holding a comment buzzes once, lightly. The fold gave the page's own slight buzz and Android's long-press buzz from the WebView came on top of it, a double vibration; the WebView's own haptic is turned off, so only the slight one is left (votes, saves and the rest keep theirs, which go through the vibrator). javacheck: compiles, 10 unit tests pass; the feel can only be checked on the phone. Asked: "I feel double vibration when holding a comment to minimize I only want a slight vibration fix it".
